newsitem.title: USA: HL&P says South Texas 2 nuke back up late Thursday.
newsitem.headline: HL&P says South Texas 2 nuke back up late Thursday.

text.p: Houston Lighting and Power Co said Thursday its 1,250 megawatt (MW) South Texas 2 nuclear unit will likely return to the electricity grid later today after it tripped off line Wednesday.
"We should be back on the grid late tonight and at 100 percent (power production) sometime tomorrow," a company spokesman said.
The unit, in Palacios, Texas, shut down Wednesday due to a problem with a feedwater regulatory valve.
"It closed when it shouldn't have," the spokesman added.
The adjacent unit 1, also rated at 1,250 MW, was operating at full power.
HL&P is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
